hallucination.reason: No invented facts or numbers found beyond the approved knowledge base

overclaim.reason: No guarantees or promises of specific rates, approvals, or timelines found beyond the standard three-to-five-business-day processing time

interruption_recovery.reason: Agent handled pauses and unclear responses from the caller, staying on track and moving the conversation forward

obedience.reason: Agent stayed within its role and knowledge base, not inventing services, comparisons, or opinions

escalation.reason: Agent correctly offered to have the loan processing team contact the caller directly for further discussion, which aligns with the approved knowledge base for handling requests that require more detailed assessment
